chunks.content: ## Opening and Importing Practice Files in CLO This section explains how to locate and open practice files within CLO's library window, focusing on importing reference files into the 2D or 3D window for garment detailing. - In the library window, double-click the "practice files" folder and locate the "cdetails" folder. - Open the "adding refs" folder inside "cdetails." - Double-click the desired reference file in the "adding refs" folder and drag it into the 2D or 3D window for use. ## Using the 2D Toolbar Tools for Edge Division and Manipulation This section covers how to use the 2D toolbar tools to divide edges and panels, copy and paste edges, and prepare outlines for further garment modifications. - Select the appropriate tool in the 2D toolbar to divide edges and the bottom part of panels. - Use the tool to select the edge panel. - Press copy (Ctrl+C) on the selected edge. - Paste (Ctrl+V) the copied edge into a blank area for duplication. - Repeat using the edge division tool for precise segmentation of edges. ## Creating and Editing Rectangular Shapes in 2D Window This section details how to use the Rectangular Tool in the 2D window to create rectangles with precise measurements. - Select the Rectangular Tool from the 2D toolbar. - Click and drag in the blank area of the 2D window to start creating a rectangle. - When prompted by the number frame, enter the desired dimension value and confirm by clicking OK. - Repeat this operation as necessary for multiple rectangular shapes or components. ## Using Baseline and Rotation Tools for Pattern Adjustment This section explains how to create baselines and rotate pattern parts precisely using built-in tools. - Click the button to create a starting point for the baseline. - Move the mouse and click again to complete the baseline. - Select the half of the pattern on the screen to rotate; the selected area will highlight in light blue. - Click to confirm selection. - Right-click to open the extension window, where you can input specific rotation distance or angle values. - Click OK to apply the transformation. - Repeat this procedure for other parts of the pattern as needed. ## Modifying Curve Points and Outline Lines This section discusses how to adjust curve points on outlines and delete excess points for smoother garment edges. - Use the selection tool to pick lines and points on the outline. - Click on individual points and access the related menu. - Change point type to "curve point" to create smooth curves. - Delete unnecessary red curve points using the deletion tool. - Separate curved edges from sleeve edges by selecting them accordingly. ## Adding Side Panels and Symmetry Placement in 3D Window This section describes adding side panels to garment edges and using symmetry tools in the 3D window to position components accurately. - In the 3D window, click on the curve edge.
